description: Provides income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments to small and marginal farmers with cultivable land.
benefits: Rs. 6,000/year (Rs. 2,000 every 4 months) direct bank transfer
language_summary_hi: किसानों को हर साल 6000 रुपए की आय सहायता तीन किस्तों में दी जाती है।

description: Provides financial assistance to homeless and those living in kutcha houses in rural areas to construct pucca houses.

excluded: Households already with a pucca house

benefits: Rs. 1.20 lakh (plain areas) or Rs. 1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) + MGNREGS wages for construction
application_process: Funds released in installments on geo-tagged photo upload
language_summary_hi: ग्रामीण इलाकों में कच्चे घरों में रहने वाले परिवारों को पक्का घर बनाने के लिए 1.20 लाख रुपए की सहायता।

state_variant.additional_benefit: Additional Rs. 50,000 top-up for SC/ST beneficiaries
state_variant.conflict_note: State eligibility requires Gujarat domicile certificate in addition to SECC listing. Central scheme does not require domicile proof — potential conflict for recent migrants.

conflict_flags: Central PMAY-G uses SECC-2011 data; state Gujarat variant requires separate domicile certificate — creates eligibility gap for recent migrants listed in SECC but lacking Gujarat domicile.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
description: Provides health insurance coverage of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization to poor and vulnerable families.
benefits: Rs. 5 lakh/year health cover per family; cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals
application_process: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or Common Service Centre
Visit any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment
language_summary_hi: गरीब परिवारों को हर साल 5 लाख रुपए तक का मुफ्त इलाज सरकारी और चुनिंदा निजी अस्पतालों में।

state_variant.additional_benefit: Covers up to Rs. 5 lakh for BPL + additional top-up for critical illness up to Rs. 25 lakh
state_variant.conflict_note: MA Yojana uses state-specific BPL list while PMJAY uses SECC-2011; a family may appear in one list but not the other.

conflict_flags: PMJAY uses SECC-2011; Gujarat's MA Yojana uses state BPL list — a citizen eligible under one may be ineligible under the other.

description: Provides free LPG connections to women from BPL/SECC households to replace traditional chulha cooking and reduce indoor pollution.

excluded: APL households not covered under SECC

benefits: Free LPG connection with first refill; EMI facility for stove and first cylinder
language_summary_hi: BPL परिवारों की महिलाओं को मुफ्त LPG कनेक्शन ताकि धुएं से मुक्ति मिले।

scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGS)
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
benefits: Minimum 100 days of employment at state-notified MGNREGS wage rate; unemployment allowance if work not provided within 15 days
application_process: Apply for Job Card at Gram Panchayat
Work assigned within 15 days within 5 km radius
language_summary_hi: ग्रामीण परिवारों को साल में 100 दिन का गारंटीशुदा रोजगार।

description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers for crop loss due to natural calamities, pests and disease.

eligibility.land_holding: Must be cultivating notified crops in notified areas
excluded: Non-loanee farmers who do not enroll voluntarily

benefits: Full insured sum for total crop loss; proportional compensation for partial loss; 2% premium for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops
application_process: Enroll at nearest bank/CSC/insurance company before cutoff date
Premium deducted from loan account automatically (loanee)
Voluntary enrollment for non-loanee farmers via app or CSC
Claims filed after crop loss survey by government
deadline: Before crop sowing cutoff (varies by crop/season)
language_summary_hi: किसानों को प्राकृतिक आपदा, कीट या बीमारी से फसल नुकसान पर बीमा कवर।

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / Ministry of Finance
description: Provides short-term formal credit to farmers for agricultural operations, post-harvest expenses, and maintenance of farm assets at concessional interest rates.
benefits: Credit limit up to Rs. 3 lakh at 7% interest (4% with prompt repayment); includes crop insurance and personal accident cover
application_process: Apply at nearest bank or PACS
Bank assesses credit limit based on land holding
language_summary_hi: किसानों को कम ब्याज दर पर खेती के लिए कर्ज के लिए किसान क्रेडिट कार्ड।

description: Provides collateral-free microloans up to Rs. 10 lakh to non-farm micro/small enterprises through banks, MFIs, and NBFCs.
benefits: Shishu: up to Rs. 50,000 | Kishore: Rs. 50,001–5 lakh | Tarun: Rs. 5–10 lakh | No collateral required
application_process: Apply at any bank, NBFC, or MFI
language_summary_hi: छोटे व्यवसायियों को 10 लाख रुपए तक का बिना गारंटी का लोन।

scheme_name: National Social Assistance Programme - Old Age Pension (NSAP-IGNOAPS)
description: Provides monthly pension to destitute elderly persons from BPL households under Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme.

excluded: Persons with other regular pension income

benefits: Rs. 200/month (Central) for age 60–79; Rs. 500/month for age 80+ (States add top-up — varies)
documents_required: Age proof (birth certificate / school certificate / Aadhaar)
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat or District Social Welfare Office
language_summary_hi: 60 वर्ष से अधिक उम्र के BPL वर्ग के बुजुर्गों को हर महीने पेंशन।

state_variant.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi Vridha Sahay Yojana (State top-up)
state_variant.additional_benefit: State adds Rs. 400/month making total Rs. 600/month for 60-79 age group
state_variant.conflict_note: Central scheme age cutoff strictly 60; Gujarat state scheme has same age but uses state BPL list which differs from national BPL list — conflict in beneficiary identification.

conflict_flags: Central IGNOAPS uses national BPL list; Gujarat top-up uses state-specific BPL list — same elderly person may be on one but not the other.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Low-cost life insurance scheme providing Rs. 2 lakh life cover for death due to any reason at an annual premium of Rs. 436.

excluded: Persons not having a savings bank account
Persons above 50 years at time of enrollment

benefits: Rs. 2 lakh on death (any cause)
application_process: Apply at bank where savings account is held
Annual premium of Rs. 436 auto-debited from account
Policy active for one year, renewable annually
language_summary_hi: मात्र 436 रुपए सालाना प्रीमियम पर 2 लाख रुपए का जीवन बीमा।

description: Accidental death and disability insurance scheme at Rs. 20/year premium for people with a savings bank account.
benefits: Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death or permanent total disability; Rs. 1 lakh for partial disability
application_process: Consent form for auto-debit of Rs. 20/year
Coverage active till 70 years of age
language_summary_hi: मात्र 20 रुपए सालाना में दुर्घटना बीमा — मृत्यु या विकलांगता पर 2 लाख रुपए।

ministry: Ministry of Women & Child Development / Health / Education
description: Multi-sector campaign to prevent gender-biased sex selective elimination and promote welfare and education of the girl child.
benefits: Scholarships, awareness drives, convergence with Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana; no direct cash — supports through education and awareness
application_process: No direct application — benefits delivered through schools, Anganwadis, and Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
language_summary_hi: बेटियों को बचाओ और पढ़ाओ — उनकी शिक्षा और सुरक्षा के लिए सरकारी अभियान।

description: Long-term savings scheme for the girl child offering higher interest rates and tax benefits to secure her education and marriage expenses.

eligibility.age_limit: Girl child below 10 years at time of account opening
excluded: More than 2 girl children per family (except twins/triplets in second birth)

benefits: 8.2% interest per annum (2024 rate); tax exemption under 80C; partial withdrawal at 18 years; maturity at 21 years
application_process: Open account at post office or bank
Minimum deposit Rs. 250/year; maximum Rs. 1.5 lakh/year
Account matures 21 years from opening or on marriage after 18
language_summary_hi: बेटी के नाम पर बचत खाता — ऊंचा ब्याज और टैक्स छूट के साथ।

scheme_name: Mid-Day Meal Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman / PM POSHAN)
description: Provides free cooked nutritious meals to students from Classes I–VIII in government and government-aided schools to improve enrolment and nutrition.
benefits: Free cooked meal on every school day; 450 kcal and 12g protein (primary); 700 kcal and 20g protein (upper primary)
application_process: Automatic for enrolled students — no separate application needed
language_summary_hi: सरकारी स्कूलों के बच्चों को हर स्कूल दिन मुफ्त पका हुआ भोजन।

description: Financial inclusion mission to provide universal access to banking, savings, credit, insurance, and pension services to unbanked citizens.

excluded: Persons already with bank account (can still open for benefits)

benefits: Zero-balance savings account; RuPay debit card with Rs. 2 lakh accident insurance; Rs. 10,000 overdraft (for account holders >6 months); life insurance Rs. 30,000
documents_required: Aadhaar Card or any official document
application_process: Visit any bank branch or Business Correspondent
language_summary_hi: बिना किसी शुल्क के बैंक खाता, डेबिट कार्ड और बीमा सुविधा।

description: Pension scheme for unorganised sector workers guaranteeing minimum monthly pension of Rs. 1,000–5,000 post retirement.

occupation: Any individual not covered by statutory pension
eligibility.income_limit: Not an income tax payer (post Oct 2022 rule)

benefits: Guaranteed pension of Rs. 1,000/2,000/3,000/4,000/5,000/month after age 60 depending on contribution; spouse pension and nominee benefit
application_process: Apply at bank or post office
Monthly contribution auto-debited from bank account
language_summary_hi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के कामगारों को 60 साल बाद हर महीने गारंटीशुदा पेंशन।

scheme_name: National Scholarship Portal - Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
description: Scholarship to SC students for pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary level education to help them complete their education.

eligibility.income_limit: Family income not exceeding Rs. 2.5 lakh per annum
excluded: Students studying via correspondence for courses where regular mode available
Students already receiving other central government scholarships

benefits: Maintenance allowance + academic fees paid directly to institution; amount varies by course level (Rs. 380–1,200/month)
language_summary_hi: SC छात्रों को पोस्ट मैट्रिक पढ़ाई के लिए छात्रवृत्ति, ताकि वे पढ़ाई जारी रख सकें।

state_variant.additional_benefit: Higher maintenance allowance than central scheme for Gujarat domicile students
state_variant.conflict_note: Central scheme income limit is Rs. 2.5 lakh; Gujarat state scheme has Rs. 1.5 lakh income limit — creates contradiction where a student earning Rs. 2 lakh qualifies centrally but not under state scheme.

conflict_flags: Central scheme income limit: Rs. 2.5 lakh/year. Gujarat state scheme income limit: Rs. 1.5 lakh/year — DIRECT CONFLICT. Student with family income Rs. 2 lakh is eligible for central but NOT state scholarship.

description: Supports artisans and craftspeople (18 traditional trades) who work with hands and tools with skill training, toolkits, credit, and market linkage.
benefits: Rs. 15,000 toolkit incentive; skill training with Rs. 500/day stipend; collateral-free loan Rs. 1 lakh (Tier 1), Rs. 2 lakh (Tier 2) at 5% interest; PM Vishwakarma certificate
application_process: Toolkit grant and credit linkage after training
language_summary_hi: पारंपरिक कारीगरों और शिल्पकारों को प्रशिक्षण, टूलकिट और सस्ता लोन।

scheme_name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
description: Provides free electricity up to 300 units/month to households installing rooftop solar panels; subsidy of up to Rs. 78,000 for installation.

eligibility.income_limit: Residential consumers — preference to EWS/LIG households

benefits: Central subsidy: Rs. 30,000 for 1 kW; Rs. 60,000 for 2 kW; Rs. 78,000 for 3 kW+; up to 300 units free electricity/month; collateral-free bank loans
application_process: DISCOM inspection and net meter installation
language_summary_hi: घर की छत पर सोलर पैनल लगाने पर सब्सिडी और मुफ्त बिजली 300 यूनिट तक।

scheme_name: National Food Security Act - Public Distribution System (NFSA-PDS)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
description: Provides subsidised food grains to eligible households (Priority Households and Antyodaya Anna Yojana) through Fair Price Shops.

eligibility.income_limit: Priority Household (as identified by state) or AAY (poorest of poor)
eligibility.gender: All (ration card in woman's name preferred)

benefits: 5 kg/month/person at Rs. 2/kg (wheat) or Rs. 3/kg (rice); AAY families get 35 kg/month at same rates
application_process: Apply for new ration card at District Food & Civil Supplies Office or e-district portal
Aadhaar seeding of all family members
Verification and card issued within 30 days
language_summary_hi: गरीब परिवारों को सस्ते दर पर गेहूं, चावल और अन्य अनाज राशन दुकान से।

scheme_name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Skill training and placement program for rural poor youth to enable them to access regular wage-based employment.
benefits: Free skill training (200–576 hours); post-placement support Rs. 1,500/month for 2 months; retention support; migration support; Rs. 1 lakh accident insurance
application_process: Contact local Project Implementing Agency (PIA) or Gram Panchayat
language_summary_hi: ग्रामीण गरीब युवाओं को नौकरी योग्य बनाने के लिए मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण और नियुक्ति।

description: Maternity benefit scheme providing cash incentive to pregnant and lactating women for partial compensation of wage loss and improved health.

eligibility.age_limit: 18 years and above (at time of pregnancy)
excluded: Women employed in Central/State Govt or PSUs already receiving maternity benefits

benefits: Rs. 5,000 in three installments (1st: Rs. 1,000 on ANC registration; 2nd: Rs. 2,000 after 6 months; 3rd: Rs. 2,000 after delivery and immunisation) for first child; Rs. 6,000 for second child if girl
application_process: Register at Anganwadi Centre or Health facility (ASHA)
Submit installment claim forms at each stage
Cash credited directly to bank account
language_summary_hi: पहली बार माँ बनने वाली महिलाओं को पाँच हजार रुपए की सहायता तीन किस्तों में।

description: Cash incentive scheme to promote institutional delivery among pregnant women from BPL/SC/ST households to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality.

eligibility.age_limit: All pregnant women (up to 2 live births)
eligibility.caste: SC/ST given priority; all BPL eligible

benefits: Rural: Rs. 1,400; Urban: Rs. 1,000 for institutional delivery; ASHA gets Rs. 300 (rural) / Rs. 200 (urban) incentive
application_process: Register at nearest government hospital or PHC
language_summary_hi: BPL / SC/ST महिलाओं को सरकारी अस्पताल में प्रसव कराने पर 1,400 रुपए की सहायता।

description: State-level agricultural development scheme providing grants to states to increase agricultural GDP through infrastructure, technology, and farmer support.
benefits: Subsidies on farm machinery (50–80%); post-harvest infrastructure support; FPO promotion grants; state-designed sub-schemes vary
application_process: Sub-scheme specific process — machinery subsidy, infrastructure grant, etc.
language_summary_hi: किसानों को कृषि यंत्र, बुनियादी सुविधाओं और तकनीक पर सब्सिडी।

scheme_name: Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) - Har Ghar Jal
description: Mission to provide safe and adequate drinking water through individual household tap connections to every rural household by 2024.

eligibility.caste: All (SC/ST habitations and vulnerable households prioritised)

benefits: Functional household tap connection (FHTC) with minimum 55 litres/person/day supply; free or at nominal cost for BPL households
documents_required: Application to Gram Panchayat / PHE department
application_process: Apply at Gram Panchayat or PHE office
Village Action Plan prepared by Gram Panchayat
language_summary_hi: हर ग्रामीण घर को नल से पीने का साफ पानी — जल जीवन मिशन।

description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore to SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises.

eligibility.gender: Women OR SC/ST (at least one per bank branch each)

benefits: Loans Rs. 10 lakh–1 crore; composite loan (term + working capital); 7-year repayment; 18-month moratorium; CGTMSE guarantee cover
application_process: Apply online at standupmitra.in or at bank branch
language_summary_hi: SC/ST और महिला उद्यमियों को नया व्यवसाय शुरू करने के लिए 10 लाख से 1 करोड़ तक का कर्ज।

description: Flagship skill certification scheme to enable Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training and improve employability.
benefits: Free skill training; government-certified NSQF qualification; placement assistance; Rs. 500/month post-placement support for 3 months; Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) certification for informally skilled workers
application_process: Find nearest Training Centre on skillindia.gov.in
Complete training and appear for assessment
language_summary_hi: युवाओं को मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण और सरकारी प्रमाण पत्र ताकि बेहतर रोजगार मिले।

description: National database of unorganised workers providing them with a UAN (Universal Account Number) for access to social security schemes.

occupation: Unorganised sector worker — construction, domestic, street vendor, farm labour, etc.

benefits: e-SHRAM card with UAN; Rs. 2 lakh accident insurance (PMSBY); priority access to all welfare schemes; portability of benefits across states
application_process: Self-register at eshram.gov.in or at nearest CSC
language_summary_hi: असंगठित मजदूरों का राष्ट्रीय रजिस्ट्रेशन, UAN कार्ड और दुर्घटना बीमा।

description: Allows parents and guardians to open National Pension System accounts for minor children to start long-term retirement savings early.

eligibility.age_limit: Minor below 18 years (account converted to regular NPS at 18)

benefits: Long-term pension corpus; same tax benefits as NPS (80CCD); flexible contribution (min Rs. 1,000/year); seamless conversion to regular NPS at 18
application_process: Open account at any NPS Point of Presence (PoP) — bank, post office, online
Submit KYC documents for minor and parent
language_summary_hi: बच्चों के नाम पर पेंशन खाता — अभी से बचत शुरू करें, बुढ़ापे में फायदा मिलेगा।

ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Gujarat
description: Gujarat state portal offering 100+ agriculture, horticulture, fisheries, and animal husbandry schemes including input subsidies, equipment subsidies, and drip irrigation assistance.

eligibility.land_holding: Land ownership required for most schemes
eligibility.gender: All (women farmers get 10% additional subsidy on equipment)
excluded: Farmers with outstanding loans in some sub-schemes

benefits: 50–75% subsidy on drip/sprinkler irrigation; 40–50% on farm machinery; seed and fertilizer subsidy; solar pump subsidy
language_summary_hi: ગુજરાતના ખેડૂતો માટે ટ્રૅક્ટર, ટ્ટ્પ સિંચાઈ, બિયારણ અને ઘઉ પર સબ્સિડી।

state_variant.additional_benefit: Farmers can claim both PM-KISAN income support AND iKhedut drip irrigation subsidy simultaneously
state_variant.conflict_note: No conflict — these are complementary. However, iKhedut requires Gujarat domicile + land records while PM-KISAN only needs land ownership. A tenant farmer eligible for PM-KISAN may NOT be eligible for iKhedut machinery subsidy that requires 7/12 in applicant's name.

conflict_flags: PM-KISAN allows tenant/sharecropper farmers via self-declaration; iKhedut requires land ownership in applicant's name (7/12 Utara) — DIRECT CONFLICT for tenant farmers in Gujarat who qualify for one but not the other.
